blocks.text: PARIS, France — Clashes broke out Saturday in Paris and other French cities amid demonstrations held a week after protests degenerated into street violence and prompted a robust security crackdown as President Emmanuel Macron sought to restore order. Police arrested nearly 1,000 people as officers faced “an extremely elevated level of violence” from black-clad “ultra-left” extremists, Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said. Riot police squads fired tear gas at protesters in the capital and in Marseille, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille, Toulouse, Montpellier and Nantes.
